title: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A twin and knight-sorceress of Eldraine's royal family who unleashes a devastating lightning bolt and discovers she can no longer planeswalk.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's twin brother, an ice mage and acting High King of Eldraine who challenges Imodane to a duel.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A scarred knight with a wooden arm and a hammer who demands tribute and styles herself queen, and who is summoned by the Faerie Lord.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Faerie Lord of the Wilds, who asks Imodane and Kellan if they are pure of heart and sends Kellan against three witches.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old half-fae boy of Orrinshire, bullied for his faerie blood, who passes through the archway to meet Talion and accepts his quest.

entities.name: Kellan's mother
entities.description: Kellan's loving mother, who tells stories and glimpsed the faerie realm once and left.

entities.name: Ronald
entities.description: Kellan's stepfather, who tells him he belongs with them.

entities.name: Hex
entities.description: The family sheepdog who runs with Kellan.

entities.name: Cerise
entities.description: A healer whom Will could ask to heal his black eye.

entities.name: Hazel
entities.description: Rowan's sibling whom she told she would be away.

entities.name: Erec
entities.description: Rowan's sibling whom she told she would be away.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: Rowan's stepmother, who fled with the children from a Phyrexian behemoth.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: One of three witches who lays in wait near her cauldron to eat heroes.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch who has taken winter's crown for herself.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch found wherever there are lovers and lords.

entities.name: Marquess of Roxburgh
entities.description: A nobleman who writes that he will not bow to a High King whose sister harms others.

entities.name: The Cotter boys
entities.description: Village boys who bully Kellan with yew and cold iron.

entities.name: Matilda
entities.description: The mother of the Cotter boys.

entities.name: The good king
entities.description: The slain king of Eldraine and Rowan and Will's father.

entities.name: Imodane's rebels
entities.description: The raiding knights who follow Imodane.

entities.name: Ardenvale knights
entities.description: The knights loyal to the old king who serve Will.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who killed the king and queen and shattered Eldraine.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The fairy tale plane recovering from the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The ruined royal castle, half-burned and abandoned.

entities.name: Castle Vantress
entities.description: The castle where Will has taken up residence.

entities.name: Castle Embereth
entities.description: The castle where Imodane once served.

entities.name: Orrinshire
entities.description: A remote sheep village that the Phyrexians neglected.

entities.name: Stormcutter Mountain
entities.description: The peak split by Rowan's lightning bolt.

entities.name: The Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse that stopped the Phyrexians but now spreads among Eldraine's citizens, with no way to wake them.

entities.name: Faerie Lord's court
entities.description: The shifting palace and silver-grassed realm of the High Faeries.

events.summary: Will and Rowan meet the rebel knight Imodane, who calls herself queen and mocks Will as pathetic.
events.quote: "The only reason I agreed to this little meeting was to see if you were as pathetic as I'd heard."

events.summary: Will proposes a duel: if Imodane loses she kneels; if she wins Will will surrender the crown of Eldraine to her.
events.quote: "I'll surrender the crown of Eldraine. You will be High Queen in name and deed."

events.summary: Will freezes the ground and Imodane slips, but she melts the ice and knocks Will to the ground with her hammer.
events.quote: Flame bursts from the head of her hammer.

events.summary: As Imodane raises her hammer over Will, Rowan unleashes a huge lightning bolt that splits the mountainside.
events.quote: Rowan's cut a massive rift into the side of the nearest peak.

events.summary: Terrified, Imodane drops her hammer and flees into the woods, while Will stares at Rowan in fear.
events.quote: Imodane drops the hammer, turns tail, and runs.

events.summary: Imodane stumbles through the woods into the throne room of the Faerie Lord, who says she was summoned and asks if she is pure of heart.
Kellan comes home bloodied by the Cotter boys, who asked whether his real father was a faerie.
events.quote: They asked if it was true my real dad was a faerie.

events.summary: Kellan's mother and stepfather say he belongs with them, but he feels longing when he looks to the woods.
events.quote: When he looks to the woods, all he feels is longing.

events.summary: Rowan tells Will she is leaving to find a magical cure for the Wicked Slumber; they argue about his unearned title and her outburst.
events.quote: You just decided to call yourself High King because you thought it suited you

events.summary: Rowan tries to planeswalk but cannot feel her spark, and says she is leaving anyway.
events.quote: She can't clear her mind enough to planeswalk.

events.summary: On a new-moon night Kellan races Hex to the willow tree and sees a translucent archway to the faerie realm.
events.quote: Ahead of him there is an archway made of ethereal, translucent stone.

events.summary: Kellan passes through the archway before his mother can stop him.
Kellan meets Talion, who asks if he is true of heart and says he will answer questions in return for service.
events.quote: "Tell me, brave hero ... Are you true of heart?"

events.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
events.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

events.summary: Kellan accepts the quest hoping to learn the truth about his father.

relations.quote: His own twin, and he can't recognize her.

relations.note: Her riders and rebels follow her
relations.quote: Nothing unites them, save their faith in Imodane

relations.note: Will seeks to make Imodane kneel
relations.quote: If I give you reason to think otherwise, you bend the knee.

relations.note: Talion sits on the throne of the Faerie realm
Kellan accepts a quest for Talion in exchange for answers
relations.quote: Render me a service, child, and you shall have your answers.
And who you are is our boy.

relations.note: Imodane is summoned to Talion's court
relations.quote: There is no need for apologies. You were summoned.
Her stepmother and her siblings running away

relations.note: The king died defending his family against the invasion
relations.quote: But the good king is dead—slain defending his family to the last
